options.name: attempt_interval
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0 Interval between attempts in seconds (value between 0 and 10).

options.name: auth_type
options.description: HTTP authentication method used by the connector.

options.name: data_type
options.description: Type of data being streamed.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the connector.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the connector is enabled. (mapped to the I(status) property of the connector object in the Zabbix API)

options.name: http_login_password
options.description: Basic Auth password

options.name: http_login_user
options.description: Basic Auth login

options.name: http_proxy
options.description: HTTP(S) proxy used by the connector.

options.name: item_value_types
options.description: Parameter introduced in Zabbix 7.0 List of value types to stream. Each element should be one of C(all), C(all+bin), C(numeric_float), C(character), C(log), C(numeric_unsigned), C(text) or C(binary). C(all) represents all types except binary I((default)). C(all+bin) represents all types, binary included.

options.name: max_attempts
options.description: Maximum number of attempts.

options.name: max_records
options.description: Maximum number of records sent in one message.

options.name: max_senders
options.description: Number of sender processes used by the connector.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the connector.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate the connector with the receiver. Supported only if C(auth_type) is one of C(basic), C(ntlm), C(kerberos) or C(digest).

options.name: ssl_cert_file
options.description: Public SSL key file path for client authentication.

options.name: ssl_key_file
options.description: Private SSL key file path for client authentication.

options.name: ssl_key_password
options.description: Password of the private SSL key file.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the connector. On C(present), it will create a connector if it does not exist or update the connector if the associated data is different. On C(absent), it will remove the connector if it exists.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags to filter streamed data.

options.name: tags_eval_type
options.description: Tag filter evaluation method.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Message sending timeout in seconds (value between 1 and 60).

options.name: token
options.description: Bearer token to authenticate the connector with the receiver. Required when C(auth_type=bearer).

options.name: url
options.description: URL of the receiver used by the connector.

options.name: username
options.description: Username to authenticate the connector with the receiver. Supported only if C(auth_type) is one of C(basic), C(ntlm), C(kerberos) or C(digest).

options.name: verify_host
options.description: Whether the connector should verify the receiver's hostname against the certificate's CN or SAN fields.

options.name: verify_peer
options.description: Whether the connector should verify the receiver's certificate.
